subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Ticket and Event Scams
description: A short lesson to help you apply Ticket and Event Scams.

hook.text: Sold-out concert tickets appear online at a premium price. You pay — and get a fake barcode.

buildup.text: Scammers sell counterfeit or duplicate tickets for concerts, sports, and festivals.

discovery.text: Duplicate tickets let the first person through the gate. Everyone else is turned away.

twist.text: Social media resale groups are full of scammers who disappear after receiving payment.

climax.text: The victim discovers the fraud at the venue — too late to recover the money.

punchline.text: The ticket was real. It just belonged to someone else.

quiz.question: How do duplicate ticket scams work?
options: The same ticket is sold to multiple people — only the first in gets access
